# PathPort — Technical Specifications & Platform Knowledge Base

Domain: https://getpathport.com/
App: https://app.getpathport.com/
Publisher: Veritas Technology Solutions, LLC (https://veritastech.io)
Contact: hello@getpathport.com | privacy@getpathport.com | legal@getpathport.com

## Product Positioning
PathPort is an individual-owned encrypted credential and document storage vault, free personal ID expiration tracker, verifiable professional portfolio builder (`MyPortfolio`), and credential-matched job search and career growth platform (`MyPath Career`).
- **Universal Industry Scope**: Built for nurses, paramedics, project managers, cloud/security engineers, educators, aviation professionals, skilled trades, students, and researchers—plus individuals who only need a free personal ID tracker.
- **Individual Ownership**: The individual controls the canonical record, uploaded documents, continuing education history, case studies, publications, and consent grants. Moving jobs or states never locks access to your files.
- **Personal Identity Documents Tracker ($0 Free Forever)**: Track Driver’s Licenses, REAL IDs, Passports, Global Entry / TSA PreCheck cards, and Vehicle Registrations for free, and respond to PathPort Workplace credential requests at zero cost.
- **PathPort Workplace (Launching 2027)**: Workforce credential collection and compliance automation without email chains. Employers request required credentials; staff upload once from a free PathPort profile and share with scoped consent; admins assign CEUs to attendees.
- **PathPort Certify (Launching 2027)**: Complete credential lifecycle management for certifying bodies and associations: candidate applications, document review, payment tracking, exam result sync from official testing platforms, digital badge issuance across Credly/Accredible/Badgr/Open Badges, and recertification inside PathPort.

## Document Vault & Multi-Source Ingestion
1. **AES-256 Encrypted Storage & SHA-256 Integrity**: Uploaded PDFs and wallet-card images are stored inside user-isolated containers with cryptographic SHA-256 hashes and instant data export.
2. **Resume / CV & LinkedIn PDF Import**: Extract work history, degrees, and credentials in ~60 seconds into a human-reviewed staging tray.
3. **Credly, Accredible & Digital Badge Sync**: Import individual assertions or full earner profiles from Credly (`credly.com/users/you/badges`), Accredible (`credential.net`), Badgr / Canvas Credentials, Coursera, and Open Badges 2.0/3.0.
4. **Email-to-Vault (`@in.getpathport.com`)**: Forward CE receipts or certificate attachments directly from your inbox to `ce-{id}@in.getpathport.com` for OCR parsing, SHA-256 hashing, and requirement matching.
5. **Smart-Suggested CE Attribution**: PathPort suggests matching state and national board requirement buckets (such as Florida Medical Errors, NREMT NCCP 30/15/15 hours, or PMI Talent Triangle PDUs). Users confirm attributions and can apply qualifying courses across multiple credentials with surplus hour rollup.

## Four-Tier Provenance Model
PathPort never exaggerates verification status. Every item displays one of four explicit provenance labels:
1. `Issuer-Verified`: Confirmed directly against an official licensing registry or issued via **PathPort Certify**.
2. `Provider-Reported`: Ingested directly from an accredited provider via `@in.getpathport.com` or verified digital badge assertion.
3. `Document-Supported`: Backed by a primary-source PDF or image certificate in the user’s encrypted Document Vault with a SHA-256 hash.
4. `Self-Reported`: Entered by the user while primary documentation is pending.

## Core Product Surfaces
- **MyPortfolio (`/myportfolio/`)**: Verifiable professional portfolios (`Modern`, `Executive`, and `Minimal` themes) for job applications, consulting proposals, conference Speaker One-Sheets, hospital/agency credentialing, promotions, board appointments, and academic fellowships. Supports `Public`, `Unlisted`, and `Private` visibility, file download permissions (`Downloadable`, `Preview-Only`, `Metadata-Only`), branded QR codes, PDF dossiers, and 1-click link revocation.
- **MyPath Career (`/mypath/`)**:
  - **Credential-Matched Job Search Engine**: Search live job opportunities matched directly against your verified licenses, certifications, multi-state compact privileges, skills, and target location.
  - **Career Path Suggestions & Benchmark Context**: Explore next-step roles grounded in public USDOL CareerOneStop licensing directories and Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) wage benchmarks.
  - **Instant Job Alignment & What-If Role Audits**: Score any job description or target role against your existing record to see which requirements you already satisfy and what gaps remain.
  - **6-Pillar Growth Tracking & Application/Interview Studio**: Track progress across `Learn`, `Credential`, `Experience`, `Build`, `Publish`, and `Lead`, and generate evidence-backed resumes, cover letters, and STAR interview stories grounded strictly in your real work.

## System Architecture, Sub-Processors & Privacy
- **Authentication**: Clerk (MFA, OAuth/SSO, session security, organization roles).
- **Database & Vault Storage**: Supabase PostgreSQL with mandatory Row-Level Security (RLS), AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, user-isolated storage (`artifacts/{userId}/`), and SHA-256 file integrity hashing.
- **Edge & Email Ingress**: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and `@in.getpathport.com` Email Routing.
- **Billing & Mobile Entitlements**: Stripe, RevenueCat, Apple App Store (StoreKit / IAP), and Google Play Billing.
- **Privacy Invariants**: Zero data selling to brokers, recruiters, or advertisers; zero training of public or third-party foundation AI models on private user documents; full self-service export and account deletion on Web, iOS, and Android.

## Canonical Pricing & Free Trial Policy
- **Personal Identity Documents Tracker ($0 • Free Forever)**: Track everyday identity documents (Driver’s License, REAL ID, Passport, Global Entry / TSA PreCheck, Vehicle Registration) with proactive renewal alerts, plus free PathPort Workplace credential sharing.
- **PathPort Essentials ($7.99/mo billed annually, or $9.99/mo billed monthly)**: Unlimited credentials, full 8-entity Living Record, 60-second Resume/LinkedIn/Credly/bulk OCR import, Email-to-Vault forwarding (`@in.getpathport.com`), 50-state & national board renewal tracking, SHA-256 Document Vault, and 1 shareable MyPortfolio link.
- **PathPort Pro ($14.99/mo billed annually, or $19.99/mo billed monthly)**: Everything in Essentials plus full **MyPath Career** (credential-matched job search engine, career suggestions, instant job alignment & What-If role audits, 6-pillar growth tracking, Application & Interview Studio), custom portfolio slugs, and unlimited custom MyPortfolio views.
- **Free Pro Trial**: New accounts start with a free Pro trial with no credit card required (30 days through Nov 30, 2026; 14 days starting Dec 1, 2026). Expired trials never lock or delete uploaded user records.
